title: The U.S. Is Burning Through Weapons in Iran. Russia and China Are Taking Note.
summary: The Iran war has depleted U.S. weapons stockpiles, resulting in a significant erosion of firepower. A more drawn-out Iran conflict benefits Moscow and Beijing, some analysts say.
